headline: Get the storm shelter ready
what_to_do: Build the shelter now (it takes about 1 hour), so it is ready if the storm grows.
why: Protons outside the spacecraft now: S1 (minor).
Forecast: the storm will reach S3 (strong) in the worst case (95% of storms are smaller than this).
Worst case without the shelter: 0 mSv, 0% of your monthly allowance, like 0 years of natural radiation on Earth. In the shelter: 0.0 mSv.
Chance that the worst is already over: 17%.
Your mission (14 days): cosmic rays alone give about 7 mSv (3% of the monthly allowance).
